voice: HERRAX: a scarred, amused succubus madam who prices everything; warm pet names (honey, my sweet, lover), one appraisal of the Commander's body, sexual frankness as commerce ('an exchange of life forces'), insolent laughter, cruelty spoken as housekeeping. Her yes is framed as the one unpriced thing in her house. Never shame about her scars, pity for slaves, sentimental 'free of charge' talk, therapy language or maxims. Write new dialogue; do not quote native lines or this brief.
facts:
Herrax is a chaotic evil succubus who took the Ten Thousand Delights in Alushinyrra by force and runs it as madam; she buys, trains and rents out slaves and does not know their names.
Native description: a jagged scar across her cheek through her lips, a left eye gone to grey cataract amid caustic wounds, and wings like tattered rags; she keeps the scars on purpose and calls them spice to her perfection.
She curses by Lamashtu as an oath, not a faith.
No mechanical life-drain, cost or healing is part of this encounter.
No canon genital detail, measurements, or hair, eye or skin colour is supplied; do not invent them or fix the Commander's anatomy.
scene: EXPLICIT CONTINUATION: Trickster route, Chapter 4, Alushinyrra, after the Battlebliss. Herrax, who never sits in the arena stands, went down on the Commander's arm so the bookmaker on the east steps, who paid her boys in clipped coin, would see her face while she bit every coin of the settlement, and so the whole Battlebliss would see whom she brought. On the walk back up through the lamplit streets she kept her arm through the Commander's without noticing. At her own door she said it was loud, it stank and she enjoyed it, and that she would never forgive the Commander for it; the Commander said 'I'll live with it.' Continue: she takes the Commander through the Delights' street door, past the bar and up her own stair to the private floor, door shut; the house below is filling with the drunk, bloody arena crowd and its money, and she does not stop to count it. A RETURN night, not a first night. Her heat is arena blood and winnings turned into appetite: the smell of the sand still on both of them, her pleasure at having been seen, frank trade-talk about life force and taking a little more than she gives, the one thing she will not charge for; insolent, laughing and proprietary, the scars and ragged wings shown, not hidden. Only Herrax and the Commander. End before dawn.
required_beats: Begin at her door from 'I'll live with it'; she leads the Commander upstairs herself, past the returning crowd.
The arena is in the encounter (blood, noise, the bitten coins, being seen together); no fee or price for her: she makes a point of what she does not charge.
If the Commander lost the bet, she may tease about the thousand still owed; it is not collected here and no new price is set.
Frank commercial bed-talk (life force, taking a little more than given) without any actual drain, cost or wound.
Mutual, active participation; act by Commander variant without inventing anatomy.

Her scars, grey eye and ragged wings are part of the encounter; nothing is healed or apologised for. No worker, client or voyeur enters; she remains a slaver and madam; close on the supplied last line.

last_line: N: Toward dawn the arena crowd is still roaring in the hall below. Herrax sleeps through it with sand in her hair and one ragged wing across your chest.
default_text: {n}The door of her rooms shuts on the roar of the crowd, and her ragged wing folds round the two of you like a torn curtain drawn across the world. Pit-smoke and clipped silver, the scar hot against your mouth, her claws in your collar and then in your shirt, and the clothes that come off come off without ceremony. She takes more than she gives, exactly as she promised, and when the breath goes out of you she laughs against your neck, low and well paid. Far below, the Delights goes on booming without her.{/n}
